dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello! Thank you for reaching out. I'm calling about my housing loan application that I submitted recently. I was wondering if you could provide me with an update on the status of my application? Has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?

This means that your loan application was approved and the loan was funded. Is there anything else you'd like to know about your loan?
